output.reason: [ev-ab4bd1639399] describes a controller bug fix: a Certificate that is being deleted no longer creates CertificateRequest or Secret objects. Whether an environment is affected depends on Certificates actually being deleted while the controller would otherwise issue for them. That happens at runtime, and no static configuration shows it. A gvk-in-use condition (P3) would flag every Certificate user, which is too broad. A deletionTimestamp field check (P2) only catches objects that happen to be terminating when the check runs, so it would miss most exposed environments. The undecidable runtime-behavior-gap condition is the accurate one.
